title: 2 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 2 Corinthians 9: the readiness of Achaia, sowing bountifully, the cheerful giver, and thanks for God's unspeakable gift.

questions.text: To whom does the writer boast about the readiness of the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he knows their readiness, of which he boasts on their behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year.

answers.text: To those of Macedonia
To the assemblies of Galatia
To the saints in Jerusalem
To the brothers in Asia

questions.text: Why did he send the brothers ahead, according to verses 3 and 4?
questions.explanation: He sent the brothers so that they might be prepared, lest anyone from Macedonia come with him, find them unprepared, and the confident boasting be a disappointment.

answers.text: So that they could take the gift to Jerusalem at once
So that he would not have to come himself
So that they would be prepared, just as he had said
So that the assemblies of Macedonia would give more

questions.text: How was the promised gift to be ready, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says the brothers were to arrange the gift ahead of time, so that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

answers.text: As a payment for their teaching
As a matter of generosity, and not of greediness
As a gift gathered only on the day he arrived
As a loan to be repaid later

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the one who sows sparingly and the one who sows bountifully?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly; he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

answers.text: Both will reap the same, whatever they sow
The one who sows sparingly will reap bountifully
Neither of them will reap anything at all
Each will reap as he has sown, sparingly or bountifully

questions.text: What kind of giver does God love, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says each man should give as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

answers.text: A giver who gives under compulsion
A cheerful giver
A giver who gives in secret
A giver who gives all he has

questions.text: What is God able to do, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says God is able to make all grace abound to them, so that, always having all sufficiency in everything, they may abound to every good work.

answers.text: To make all grace abound to them, so that they may abound to every good work
To remove all affliction from them at once and forever
To give them letters of commendation to the saints
To raise the dead at the sound of the last trumpet

questions.text: What is written about the one described in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 quotes: He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.

answers.text: That he gathered much and yet had nothing at all left over
That he was rich, yet for their sakes he became poor for them
That he has scattered abroad, has given to the poor, and his righteousness remains forever
That he sowed sparingly and therefore also reaped sparingly

questions.text: What does verse 10 say God supplies?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says he supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, and asks that he supply and multiply their seed for sowing and increase the fruits of their righteousness.

answers.text: Water for the thirsty and oil for the lamps
Gold and silver for the temple
Rain in its season and wine for the feast
Seed to the sower and bread for food

questions.text: For what do the saints glorify God, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says that through the proof given by this service they glorify God for the obedience of their confession to the Good News of Christ, and for the generosity of their contribution.

answers.text: For the obedience of their confession to the Good News and the generosity of their contribution
For the letters which they sent to the assemblies of Macedonia
For the apostles who had been appointed over them in Achaia
For the riches which they had gathered up for themselves there

questions.explanation: Verse 15 ends: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

answers.text: With a greeting from the assemblies of Asia
With thanks to God for his unspeakable gift
With a warning against unbelievers
With a request to be sent on to Judea
